Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases.

As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool.

A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time.

What You'll Do

  • Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers

  • Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet)

  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail

  • File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve

  • Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship

  • Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria

  • Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4)

How We Work

We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer.

We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality:

Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal):

  • Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other..

  • Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint.

  • 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.

  • Monthly Engineering all-hands.

  • That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Deployments:

  • Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.

  • Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Communication:

  • Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

  • Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion

  • Google Workspace for email and documents.

  • Zoom for video calls.

Timezone:

  • We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet.


What We're Looking For

Requirements (Requisite Skills): 

  • 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing

  • 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer)

  • 2+ years of experience using TypeScript

  • Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation

  • Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication

  • Strong experience in manual testing and writing manual test cases

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accessibility and/or security testing

How you’ll work with other teams:

Career Growth

We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there.

Onboarding

Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza.

What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to.

Interview Process

Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check in accordance with applicable law. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides.

Ready to apply?

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves a screening call, followed by a behavioral interview, and two technical interviews.

A direct line to the founders, real budget for tooling, and a mandate to change how the revenue team works, from day one.

Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
  • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
  • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
  • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
  • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
  • Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
  • Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
  • Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
  • Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
  • Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.


Meet your team

You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

Deine Mission

syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden, zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können.
  • Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz.
  • Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert.
  • Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen.


Dein Profil

  • Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. 
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten.
  • Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne.
  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und kannst dich gut im Team koordinieren.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2).
  • Pluspunkt: Du hast Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen Architektur oder PropTech und erste Programmiererfahrungen mit Python.


Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster (ca. 1 Tag pro Woche im Office)
  • Anstellungsart: Werkstudium (12-20 Std./Woche, Zeiten flexibel)


Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.
    • BusinessBike: Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen.

description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
  • Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.
  • Du entscheidest ob Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.
  • Urlaub, der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. 
  • Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner.
  • Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.


Das sind WIR

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Mit avenit und Vusyon vereinen wir zwei starke Kräfte - langjährige führende Digitalexpertise und modernste KI-Technologie - zu einem Partner für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet.

Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Mehr erfährst du hier: https://vusyon.ai/

description:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m EUR funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

Your Role

We are looking for an engineer with strong backend, data, and AI systems experience to build the evaluation and observability foundation for production-grade LLM agents used in complex audit workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, data infrastructure, and AI quality. You will build the evaluation systems that power our multimodal retrieval agents and continuously improve critical quality metrics across current and future pipelines.

You’ll work at the edge of applied AI and information retrieval, building multimodal agentic pipelines and solving hard context and agent-harness engineering problems.

This is not a traditional analytics, BI, or dashboarding role. You should expect to write production code, design data architecture, work inside backend systems, and directly improve the quality, cost, reliability, and performance of LLM-based agents.

What you’ll do

You will help build and operate the technical systems around our AI agents, with a focus on data infrastructure, evaluation, observability, and optimization. You will:

  • Build online and offline evaluation systems for LLM agents, including pipelines that use golden datasets, ground-truth data, human review workflows, and experiment results.

  • Create automated quality gates so changes to prompts, context, models, or agent logic can be tested before reaching production.

  • Analyze large volumes of agent traces and executions in columnar and analytical databases such as BigQuery or ClickHouse to identify failure modes, quality regressions, latency issues, reliability gaps, and cost optimization opportunities.

  • Build reliable data retention and replay mechanisms for long-term analysis of production agent behavior.

  • Manage observability tools for tracing, monitoring, debugging, and experiment management of our audit agents.

  • Team up with backend engineers to improve the speed and reliability of our retrieval and reasoning agents.

You will fit into the role if you...

  • Have strong Python and/or backend engineering experience.

  • Have a solid understanding of how LLM and agent systems are evaluated—including deterministic checks, ground truth, LLM-as-judge, human review, and quality metrics—and can reason about when each approach is appropriate.

  • Have deployed and operated systems in the cloud, ideally on GCP.

  • Have hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval or ML pipeline evaluation systems and using LLM observability or experimentation tools such as Braintrust, MLflow, Langfuse, or Weights & Biases.

  • Are comfortable working with analytical databases, data warehouses, columnar stores, and high-volume event or trace data.

  • Understand system design, reliability, observability, monitoring, logging, debugging, and operational trade-offs.

  • Bring senior-level engineering judgment: you can make architectural decisions, communicate trade-offs, and build systems that other engineers can extend.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity, able to reason from first principles, and excited to build infrastructure for AI systems that are actively used in production.

Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Designing data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, event-processing systems, or feedback loops for production data.

  • Building infrastructure around LLM-based products or agentic systems, including optimizing LLM usage, context windows, reasoning tokens, or model selection.

  • Working with production traces from complex distributed systems.

  • Building internal platforms for engineers, domain experts, or operations teams.

  • Using workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal or similar.

  • Familiarity with audit, finance, compliance, or other high-accuracy domains.

  • Experience in an early-stage startup or fast-moving engineering environment.

No-one checks every box. If you’ve shipped retrieval systems and like owning evaluations and pipelines, let’s talk.

What we offer

  • High impact & growth: Shape strategy at a scaling AI startup from day one.

  • Mission-driven culture: Ambitious team valuing first-principles thinking and bold ideas.

  • Attractive compensation: competitive salary plus significant equity.

  • Best tools for the job: Generous coding tools budget so you can use the best tools for the job.

  • Startup perks: Flexible vacation, team lunches, retreats, central Berlin office.

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro to Cortea with Liza

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Vlad

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

We’re an equal-opportunity team and encourage women and underrepresented groups to apply.

description:
Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.


On AI

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.


What you'll do

Four areas, roughly in the order you will spend time on them. You won't work on all of them at once, but you should be open to any of them.

Product platform. Make the easiest way for product engineers to do something (the paved road, or golden path) also the most secure, reliable and scalable way by default. Build the shared primitives, libraries and APIs that hide complexity and carry our quality and observability standards with them. Own the architecture and the core stack: what gets standardized, what gets reused, and where the system should be in eighteen months.

Infrastructure, observability and reliability. Infrastructure as code by default, from cloud resources through to dashboards and alerts. Provision, run and tune our Kubernetes cluster and cloud footprint, and keep CI fast as the deploy rate grows. Define SLIs for the workloads that
matter, build SLOs on top of them, and make the alerting high-signal enough that people trust it. Drive down AI and infrastructure spend.

Security and compliance. Keep the internal foundations secure by default: IAM, dependency management, secrets. Own the authentication and authorization stack, including ReBAC models covering both humans and agents. Implement SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls without taxing every future change.

AI dev tooling. Keep product engineers and their agents on the paved road by making sure the documentation and agent guidelines they need are in place. Shorten the path from design to implementation with standardized automations and development environments that stay close to production.


What this looks like in practice

  • A system of record for managing and distributing constantly evolving agent configurations, under strict auditability and tenant isolation requirements

  • The harnesses powering our AI agents, abstracting over use cases that change faster than the code

  • Centralized progress tracking that holds up across a growing number of parallel agent executions

  • Usage-based tenant billing with quotas and rate limiting across a growing set of products

  • SLIs for the background job system behind our agents (execution latency, AI spend, memory, CPU), then fixing the bottlenecks they expose at both the application and infrastructure level

  • A document pipeline handling dozens of file formats, very large spreadsheets and hundreds of parallel uploads, under a strong reliability requirement


You will fit into this role if you…

  • Have designed, built and operated distributed systems end to end, and enjoy understanding how every part interacts with the rest

  • Are strong at backend software engineering and at DevOps/SRE, and don't think of those as separate jobs

  • Write design docs, RFCs, ADRs, postmortems

  • Reach for simple, boring solutions first, can tell essential complexity from accidental, and know which corners are safe to cut and which ones compound

  • Can turn a hard problem on its head and find the alternative nobody proposed

Concretely, you have scaled Postgres or another relational transactional database under real load, run production Kubernetes, and built observability rather than inherited it: SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing.

No one checks every box. If you have designed a system from scratch, run it in production, and can explain in writing why it is shaped the way it is, let's talk.


Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Durable workflow orchestrators like Temporal, and background job and queue processing generally

  • Infrastructure for LLM-based products or agentic systems

  • Audit, finance, compliance, or another high-accuracy domain

  • Azure and/or GCP


This is probably not the right role if…

  • You would describe application code as someone else's responsibility. A large share of platform work here happens inside the product codebase.

  • Your answer to reliability is more process. We want guardrails, not gates.

  • You need a well-defined system to work in. Ours is not one yet, and shaping it is the job.


What you will get

  • You own the brand and shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry. From Berlin, with AI at the core.


Interview process

  • First Call — Intro to Cortea with Liza

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Dan

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

description:
At atmo, we've built a core AI product at the intersection of agricultural transition and green finance. As an early-stage company moving from first rollout to scale, we're looking for a hands-on Founding Engineer to join our founding team and help build the AI backbone of our product.

Over the past year, we've deliberately evolved from a pure data product into an AI-first platform. AI is now central to everything we do - from ingesting messy, real-world agricultural data to unlocking new financing flows for sustainable farming. We're looking for someone who wants to get hands-on: building and managing the AI agents that power the product, and working closely with our CSO to turn science models into shipped features.

About atmo

atmo is building the infrastructure for financing the transition of agriculture.

Agriculture is facing massive pressure to adapt - from climate change and rising input costs to new technologies and changing market requirements. Yet farmers and their financing partners often lack the data, tools and business cases needed to make the right investment decisions.

atmo is an AI-powered Agriculture Finance OS that brings farm, climate and financial data together to turn complex agricultural transition investments into clear, bankable business cases. Our platform helps farmers identify profitable transition opportunities, assess ROI and financing needs, access relevant solution providers and generate bank-ready financing reports. For banks and other financial institutions, atmo provides the data and decision intelligence needed to confidently finance the next generation of agricultural investments.

We work across the agricultural ecosystem, including farmers, banks, solution providers and food companies, and are already active in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with partnerships and pilots across leading financial and agricultural organisations.

Founded in Berlin in 2023, atmo is backed by leading investors, accelerators and non-dilutive funding programmes. We are a lean, ambitious team combining deep expertise in agriculture, finance, climate science, AI and B2B SaaS - with the goal of making agricultural transition investable at scale.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Build, run and continuously improve the LLM pipelines at the heart of atmo's product - classifying farm records, soil samples and financial statements, extracting structured data from them, and generating bank-ready reports - from prompting and orchestration to evaluation and monitoring
  • Own the platform end-to-end: a Python/FastAPI backend, Next.js web apps and the AWS infrastructure they run on
  • Partner closely with our CSO on the scientific engine, defining the interface between science and product and turning new models into production-ready features
  • Make AI outputs trustworthy: evaluations, guardrails and clear provenance, so every number in a financing case can be traced back to its source
  • Ship fast and iterate constantly, using modern AI tooling to move with a small, high-leverage team

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on builder - you'd rather be in the codebase than in a meeting
  • Strong Python backend depth (FastAPI or similar, SQL, background jobs), comfortable across the stack in TypeScript/Next.js and owning infrastructure on AWS
  • Practical experience running LLM-based systems in production, not just prototypes: structured extraction, evaluation, cost and latency, handling failures gracefully
  • Comfortable working directly with scientific/domain experts, like our CSO, to turn models into shipped features
  • Fast-paced, get-it-done mindset - thrives in ambiguity and on a lean team, and takes ownership of technical decisions, not just tickets
  • Mission-aligned: genuine interest in climate, sustainable agriculture, and green finance
  • Bonus: exposure to fintech, agritech, or applied climate/agricultural science; German helps, as much of our farm data is German

Benefits

Why atmo

Building at atmo means shaping both the technology and the science behind it, side by side with the founding team. This role gives you the chance to:

  • Own the AI and data layer of a real climate-impact product, with real farmers and banks on the other end
  • Work side by side with the founding team and our CSO, shaping both product and science
  • A startup-stage compensation package with meaningful equity and substantial ownership from day oneSmall team (5 FTE), real impact, no layers

📍 Location: Hybrid, with a preference for London / Berlin
🌱 Womxn are encouraged to apply

If you're excited to build the AI and systems behind real climate and finance impact - we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. Every permanent team member gets equity, so when we grow, you do too. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.

This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers by designing and delivering scalable integrations. It bridges the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE) to accelerate time-to-value within defined scope, timeline, and budget.


About You

  • Technical Expertise: You have strong hands-on experience with SQL, relational databases, APIs, enterprise integration patterns, and scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang).

  • Language & Communication: You possess proven ability to explain complex technical concepts effortlessly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

  • AI Leverage: You fluently use AI coding assistants and automation tools to accelerate spec drafting, data analysis, and code development securely.

  • Mindset & Approach: You are a self-directed, customer-first problem solver who context-switches easily, balances standard methodologies with edge-case judgment, and prioritises team success.

How Will I Spend My Time?

  • Delivering Technical Solutions: Scoping, designing, building, testing, and handing off standard integration and automation projects end-to-end within defined timelines and budgets.

  • Partnering Across GTM & Engineering: Collaborating with Account Executives during pre-sales, joining forces with CSMs and Onboarding Managers to accelerate deployment, and bridging customer feedback to Product, Design & Engineering to shape the roadmap.

  • Building Scalable Tooling: Identifying recurring technical patterns to build shared scripts, templates, and automations that reduce delivery effort across all customer accounts.

  • Managing Scope & Architecture: Advising customers on sustainable system architecture, managing package boundaries, and escalating custom requirements effectively.

 

At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • Remote flexible working arrangements

  • Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy

  • Quarterly celebrations and team events

  • Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices.

We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. We seek to make reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process to create an even playing field for all candidates. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK .

Even if you don't meet every requirement listed in the ad, please consider applying for this role. We prioritise inclusion and value individuals with potential over a checklist of qualifications. Don't rule yourself out, hit that apply button if this job resonates with you

You can find out more about life at Mitti via Youtube , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn.

To all recruitment agencies, we do not accept resumes or partnership opportunities. Please do not forward resumes to Mitti or any of our employees. We are not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

description:
The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software.

The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software.
  • Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities.
  • Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance.
  • Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements.
  • Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms.
  • Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments.
  • Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.
  • Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop.

    • Required Qualifications
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle.

Hunderttausende Menschen, die nicht am Schreibtisch arbeiten, öffnen Flip, um alles zu erreichen, was die digitale Welt ihres Unternehmens für sie bereithält. Du bringst einen Flip-Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite.

  • Integrationen, die Flip tragfähig machen: Du designst und lieferst Identity und Authentifizierung (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), SCIM-Provisioning, REST-APIs und Anbindungen an HR- und operative Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Beraten und befähigen statt selbst abarbeiten: Du führst die IT auf Kundenseite, ihre Partner und unsere externen Entwicklungspartner zu einer Lösung, die du selbst unterschreiben würdest, und sorgst dafür, dass sie ohne dich betrieben werden kann.

  • Bauen, wo es den Rollout löst: Wo Bauen der schnellste Weg ist, einen Ansatz zu belegen oder ein Rollout wieder in Bewegung zu bringen, baust du die erste Version und übergibst sie danach sauber, mit Dokumentation und Übergabegespräch, damit sie Bestand hat.

  • KI dort, wo sie auf den Kunden trifft: Du gestaltest, wie Agents, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und Agent-to-Agent-Szenarien in echten Enterprise-Umgebungen ankommen, inklusive der Auth- und Datengrenzen, die dabei halten müssen.

  • Technische Autorität im Account: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit Projektleitung, IT, Security, Fachbereichen und Betriebsräten ab, entscheidest die technischen Fragen und gibst die Lücken, die du dabei siehst, an unser Produkt- und Engineering-Team zurück. Rechne mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kund:innen, etwa 10 bis 30 Prozent deiner Zeit.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Rund 3 bis 5 Jahre (oder mehr) in der IT- oder Tech-Beratung, im Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering oder in der SaaS-Implementierung, mit echter Enterprise-Erfahrung.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integration und Identity: SSO und Authentifizierung (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID oder vergleichbar), REST-APIs und API-basierte Integrationen, die du in echten Enterprise-IT-Landschaften geliefert hast.

  • Technische Verantwortung am Kunden in Enterprise-Projekten, in denen du die technischen Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit IT, Security und Fachbereichen getroffen und nicht nur koordiniert hast.

  • Echte technische Tiefe, ohne in Vollzeit Produktcode zu schreiben: Du liest Code, prüfst ein Design, debuggst eine Integration und baust einen funktionierenden Prototypen.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher und fließendes Englisch.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit SCIM-Provisioning und Anbindungen an HR- oder Workforce-Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Ein fundierter, aktueller Blick darauf, wohin sich agentische KI entwickelt: MCP, A2A, EMA und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Feld eng verfolgt und eine eigene Meinung dazu hat, keine Jahre an Erfahrung, die es noch nicht geben kann.

  • Vorerfahrung als Customer Engineer oder Forward Deployed Engineer in einem Produktunternehmen statt ausschließlich in der klassischen Beratung.

  • Tools zur Workflow-Automatisierung (n8n oder ähnlich), Routine mit Logs, Metriken und Dashboards oder Erfahrung mit Mitbestimmung und Datenschutz im Enterprise-Umfeld.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an.

  • Erfolge feiern: Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du gestaltest Flip aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen.

  • Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen.

Empower every employee.

At Flip, we have a clear goal: to revolutionize the world for frontline workers and give them a voice. If you're ready to make an impact and shape the work lives of millions of people, then you've come to the right place!

Our Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

Flip is the frontline employee experience platform. Hundreds of thousands of people who do not work at a desk open Flip to reach everything their employer's digital world holds for them and Bosch, REWE and Porsche are a a few of the companies that run it. The hard part is the last mile into a decades-old enterprise IT landscape, and that last mile is this role.

As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a Flip tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.

What you can expect

  • Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.

  • Integrations that make Flip load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you.

  • Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.

  • AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.

  • Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.

  • Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.

  • Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.

  • German at C1 level or above and fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.

  • Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.

  • Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

Flip is the frontline employee experience platform. Hundreds of thousands of people who do not work at a desk open Flip to reach everything their employer's digital world holds for them and Bosch, REWE and Porsche are a a few of the companies that run it. The hard part is the last mile into a decades-old enterprise IT landscape, and that last mile is this role.

As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a Flip tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. Must-haves

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production. You will work closely with our core business units to develop a reliable supply chain and strengthen compliance.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

  • At least 4 years of disciplinary leadership and people management experience, ideally with responsibility for teams with 5+ employees

  • Experience in a startup/scale-up environment or complex corporate organization, ideally in semiconductor, pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry

  • Deep expertise in supply chain management, material flow, inventory management, production support and import/export regulations

  • Strong hands-on experience with WMS and ERP systems (SAP/S/4HANA experience is a plus)

  • Fluent German language skills (minimum: C1) and good English (minimum: B2)

What Makes This Role Different

Rather than maintaining existing playbooks, this is your chance to build a modern logistics function from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to shape the function from an early stage and define how logistics and supply chains should work at Black Semiconductor.

Your decisions will have a direct impact on our ability to operate, produce and scale. You will have the freedom to bring your expertise, challenge existing ways of working and build the team, processes and standards you believe are needed.

If you enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, taking ownership and building something that will grow with the company, this is an opportunity to make a real difference.

Our Work Culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters.

Let's Grow Together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development.

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority — in the present and future.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward.

We connect chips — and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

We are looking for a Product Owner AI (m/f/d) to take ownership of a new AI-based medical device. You will own the product's technical specification, backlog and requirements end-to-end, from feature scoping through implementation and international roll-out, acting as the central point between our medical, regulatory, and AI team.   • Translate medical and business requirements into clear technical specifications and a prioritized backlog, based on input from users, markets, and internal stakeholders
